name: dukaos
description: Duka System: the offline-first digital business partner for a Kenyan mini-mart.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @duka/api" "npm run dev -w @duka/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @duka/shared && npm run typecheck -w @duka/web && npm run typecheck -w @duka/api
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
